I1.quote: Hydrogen adsorption measurements of activated carbons were carried out in a Hiden IMI PSI brand hydrogen storage device at 77 K. Before analysis, the materials were degassed at 105°C for 4 hours.
I1.location: main, p. 3 (journal p. 552), Section 2.3 Hydrogen storage analysis

I2.quote: In this study, two different biomass sources, horse chestnut and tangerine peel, were used to produce activated carbon. Zinc chloride (ZnCl₂) used as the activation agent was supplied by Sigma-Aldrich.
I2.location: main, p. 2 (journal p. 551), Section 2 General Methods

I3.quote: Activated carbon produced from horse chestnut shells exhibited a very high storage capacity with a hydrogen storage capacity of 1.90% by weight at 1 bar, 4.24% at 20 bar and a maximum of 4.47% at 80 bar.
I3.location: main, p. 3 (journal p. 552), Section 3.1 and Table 1 (77 K stated in Section 2.3 and in the Figure 3 text, main p. 4, journal p. 553)

I4.quote: The BET surface area of the horse chestnut-based activated carbon was determined as 2128 m²/g, while this value was at the level of 1230 m²/g for the tangerine peel-based activated carbon.
I4.location: main, p. 3 (journal p. 552), Section 3.1 and Table 1 (SBET column)

I5.quote: In this study, the hydrogen storage capacities and adsorption behaviors of activated carbons obtained from agricultural wastes such as tangerine peel and horse chestnut were investigated in detail.
I5.location: main, p. 1 (journal p. 550), Abstract, first sentence

notes: Primary research article (Sakarya Univ. J. Sci., 2025); record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice found in the text (searched retract/withdraw). The paper does not name the instrument class (gravimetric vs volumetric) beyond 'Hiden IMI PSI hydrogen storage device'; H2 uptake isotherms are its own measurement at 77 K up to 80 bar (Figure 3, Table 1), plus uptake versus time at 33, 55 and 80 bar in mmol/g (Figure 5, Table 4), so I1 is judged met. Both samples are ZnCl2-activated biomass carbons with BET areas measured on the same carbons (N2 at 77 K, Section 2.2). Synthesis procedures are cited to earlier papers ([16], [18]) but the paper nowhere states that its H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply.
